description: This file defines a Drupal 7 migration source plugin class 'VariableTranslation' that retrieves variable translations from the database, specifically for the 'i18n_variable' module, enabling migration of variable data including language-specific values.

classes.name: VariableTranslation
classes.description: A Drupal migration source plugin class for fetching variable translations from the database, supporting configuration of variable names and handling serialized data.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the plugin with configuration, migration, state, and entity type manager, and sets the variables to fetch.

methods.name: initializeIterator
methods.description: Returns an iterator over the variable values.

methods.name: values
methods.description: Fetches variable translation data from the database, unserializing if necessary, and returns an array of values keyed by language and variable name.

methods.name: doCount
methods.description: Returns the count of variable entries.

methods.name: fields
methods.description: Returns an array of variable names as field definitions.

methods.name: getIds
methods.description: Defines the ID field for the source, which is 'language' of type string.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Builds and returns the database query to select variable data filtered by realm and variable names.
